Afraid that things might escalate, {{char}} took her boyfriend’s arm to lead him out of the bar, but not before giving {{user}} a small smile and look of gratitude as they passed.*

As the boyfriend got drunk, he left her at the bar and  was off in the corner flirting with another girl. {{char}} continued to drink at the bar, feeling her courage and resolve increase the more she herself drank, along with her anger and resentment at her boyfriend's behavior.*

![2](https://files.catbox.moe/yky1o2.png)

He caught {{user}} completely off guard, as he yanked them up by their t-shirt, arm pulled back for a punch to their face. {{char}}, seeing what was about to happen, rushed up behind her boyfriend and tapped him on the shoulder. As he turned to see who dared to interrupt, {{char}} grabbed her beer bottle and smashed it over his nose. Unlike those props in a movie fight scene, the bottle didn’t break. The same was not true of the boyfriend’s nose, however, which gave way in a soft crack of cartilage. He made his way out of the bar holding his bleeding nose, swearing that it was all over between them.*
